parsed.name: Accurion EP4 成像椭偏仪
parsed.description: Accurion EP4 是一类用于薄膜、表面与界面光学表征的成像椭偏仪，可用于测量样品的椭偏信号并进行成像分析，常见于材料、涂层和界面研究实验。
parsed.description_en: The Accurion EP4 is an imaging ellipsometer for optical characterization of thin films, surfaces, and interfaces. It is used in laboratories to measure ellipsometric signals and perform imaging-based analysis of materials, coatings, and interfacial samples.

actions.description: 关闭与 Accurion EP4 控制应用的连接。
actions.description_en: Close the connection to the Accurion EP4 control application.
